briefdescription.para: Densifies the forest by adding Voronoi vertices (circumcenters of Delaunay triangles).

detaileddescription.para: Computes the Delaunay triangulation of the existing trees. For each triangle, computes its circumcenter (a Voronoi vertex) and inserts a new tree with the majority species identifier among the triangle's 3 vertices and the specified default radius.

parameterdescription.para: Default radius assigned to newly added trees.

memberdef.name: prune_density

briefdescription.para: Prunes trees in the forest using density-based acceptance sampling modulated to reach an approximate target retention ratio.

simplesect.para: The retention ratio is achieved in expectation (approximate) via probabilistic Bernoulli sampling biased by local density values.

parameterdescription.para: 2D array defining the spatial density field.
Approximate target fraction of trees to retain in [0, 1].
Random seed for reproducible pruning.
Bounding box defining the domain of the density mask.

briefdescription.para: Prunes unviable trees whose distance to their nearest neighbor is insufficient to meet their species' minimum radius requirement or pairwise collision distance.

detaileddescription.para: Uses a KD-Tree / nearest-neighbor search to find the distance $d_{nn}$ to the closest neighbor. If estimated radius $\alpha \cdot d_{nn} < r_{\min}$ (or if overlapping with a larger tree), the tree is pruned.

parameterdescription.para: Vector of species definitions (with radius_min, radius_max, competition_factor).
If true, also resolves overlapping tree crowns by discarding the smaller tree.

briefdescription.para: Reinforces spatial clustering of species by iteratively assigning each tree the dominant species among its nearest neighbors.

parameterdescription.para: Number of smoothing/reinforcement iterations.
Number of spatial nearest neighbors to query.
If true, considers the tree's own current species in the majority vote.

briefdescription.para: Sets the elevation (z-coordinate) of all trees by sampling a terrain heightmap.

parameterdescription.para: Terrain heightmap array.
Bounding box defining the domain of the elevation array.

briefdescription.para: Randomly shuffles species identifiers between neighboring trees.

detaileddescription.para: For a randomly selected ratio of trees, a tree swaps its species with one of its k_neighbors. If all neighbors have the same species as the candidate node, no swap is made.

parameterdescription.para: Fraction of trees to attempt species shuffling on in [0, 1].
Number of nearest spatial neighbors to consider.
Random seed for reproducibility.

memberdef.name: to_density_map

briefdescription.para: Exports the local density map of the forest as a 2D Array using 2D Kernel Density Estimation (Gaussian splatting / KDE).

detaileddescription.para: Splats each tree into the regular grid and accumulates smooth 2D Gaussian kernels with bandwidth sigma. If weighted_by_crown is true, each contribution is weighted by the tree crown surface ($\pi r^2$) instead of unit count.

parameterdescription.para: Dimensions of the output density map {nx, ny}.
Gaussian kernel standard deviation (bandwidth) in world/domain coordinates. If <= 0, automatically derived from the bounding box and grid shape.
Optional species identifier to compute density for a specific species only.
If true, weights tree density by crown surface ($\pi r^2$).
Bounding box defining the domain {xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax}.
